canonical_example.text: Todavía tengo la Biblia antigua de mi abuelo.
canonical_example.translation: I still have my grandfather's old Bible.

canonical_example.translation: Phoenicia was an ancient civilization.

canonical_example.text: Estoy felizmente casada, pero todavía me acuerdo de mi antiguo novio.
canonical_example.translation: I'm happily married, but I still think about my old boyfriend.

canonical_example.translation: My former boss has been promoted to the post of Regional Director.

canonical_example.translation: She was dressed in an old-fashioned black dress that covered her from head to toe.

canonical_example.translation: Her husband has an outdated mindset, and doesn't allow her to work.
